sections.prompt_context:
Generate 3 to 5 numbered paragraphs. Do not state or suggest that any offence is complete when the cheque is issued, presented or dishonoured. On liability, use only the sentence given. This is a STATUTORY DEMAND NOTICE — tone must be firm and legal. Structure:
Para 1: State the underlying liability — {underlying_liability}.
Para 2: State that towards discharge of said liability, the noticee ({respondent_name}) issued Cheque No. {cheque_number} dated {cheque_date} for Rs. {cheque_amount}/- ({amount_in_words}) drawn on {drawee_bank}, {drawee_branch}.
Para 3: State that the cheque was presented to the payee's bank on {presentation_date} and was returned dishonoured vide bank's return memo dated {dishonour_date} with the endorsement '{dishonour_reason}'.
Do NOT generate the demand clause or closing — those are template-handled.

sections.template:
{demand_heading}

I therefore call upon you to pay my client the said amount of Rs. {cheque_amount}, being the amount of the said cheque, within fifteen days of receipt of this notice. If you fail to pay the said amount within fifteen days of receipt of this notice, an offence punishable under Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act, 1881 will be complete, and my client will initiate proceedings against you.

filing_checklist: Send the notice within 30 days of receiving the bank's return memo (Section 138, proviso (b)).
Send via Registered Post AD — retain postal receipt
Send additional copy via Speed Post / UPC for safety
Retain original dishonoured cheque safely (primary evidence)
Retain bank return memo / dishonour slip
Wait 15 days from date of receipt by noticee
If payment is not made within 15 days of receipt of the notice, file the complaint within one month after those 15 days end (Section 142(1)(b)).
Keep AD card as proof of service
Verify noticee's correct residential / business address
